name: 🎯 Deadeye[UPD]
desc:
🎯 Quick-shooting to eliminate your enemies.
🔫 Everyone uses a sniper rifle, paired with different abilities.
There are Free for All and Team Deathmatch modes, with more in development.
The game is still in Beta. Join the social channels to provide feedback and suggestions.
💻🎮📱 Playable on all devices, with in-game control tips for easy learning.

🔪 No appeals are accepted for bans due to cheating reports.

Inspired by Flick.
